answer_1.quote: This work presents FACT-PICO, an expert-constructed factuality benchmark for the plain language summarization of technical abstracts describing RCTs.
answer_1.outputs: plain language summaries of RCT abstracts

answer_2.quote: We first evaluate a suite of existing automatic factuality metrics shown to be effective in prior work. (1) Dependency-Arc Entailment (DAE)... (2) QuestEval... (3) QAFactEval... (4) AlignScore... We also report ROUGE-L, Flesch‑Kincaid Grade and BERTScore.

answer_3.quote: We also present an analysis of methods to evaluate factuality, including both dedicated factuality models and novel LLM-based methods.

answer_4.quote: FACTPICO was annotated by two senior students in their fifth year of medical school who are highly proficient in English. We ask evaluators to provide a rating between 1 to 4 for each PICO element, evidence inference and added information, and to provide natural‑language rationales.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rate each PICO element, evidence inference, and added information on a 1‑4 scale and justify their rating with a free‑text rationale.
